enzo.verdict: Self-hosted AI workspace with agents, 74 skills, and Gmail/Calendar tools
overview: ENZO is a self-hosted AI workspace that bundles agents with 74 ready-made skills and real tools like Gmail and Calendar. It runs from a single Docker container and lets you bring your own API keys from providers like Groq, OpenRouter, or NVIDIA. The result is a personal AI operations hub that lives on your own hardware.
pros: Bring your own keys keeps data private
cons: Relatively small project with limited traction
BYOK means ongoing model API costs
Single-install Docker model limits scaling

epsillion.verdict: AI document automation and data extraction platform.
overview: Epsillion is a document automation tool that uses AI to extract structured data from files like invoices, contracts, and forms. It is designed to replace manual data entry in back-office workflows with automated pipelines. The company was founded in 2025.

eraser-io.verdict: AI co-pilot for technical diagrams and documentation built for engineering teams.
overview: Eraser is a docs and diagramming tool built for engineering teams, combining a canvas with a diagram-as-code workflow. Its AI co-pilot generates flowcharts, ER diagrams, cloud architecture, and sequence diagrams from plain descriptions. Engineers can then edit diagrams by typing rather than dragging shapes.

everyday.verdict: Personal AI assistant that executes everyday tasks and multi-step workflows.
overview: Everyday is an AI productivity assistant that takes plain-English requests and carries out everything from simple tasks to complex, multi-step workflows across apps. It acts as a digital partner for managing emails, schedules, and work processes, turning intentions into completed outcomes. The platform features community-shared workflow examples users can adopt.
cons: Pricing details not public

excel-formularizer.verdict: Get Excel formulas written by AI
overview: Excel Formularizer is an AI assistant that writes and explains Excel and Google Sheets formulas from plain-language descriptions. It offers a free tier with a Pro plan at $4.99 per month. The tool suits anyone who struggles with spreadsheet syntax.
cons: Pro at $4.99/mo for full power
Limited to formula help

excel-whisper.verdict: AI Excel analysis tool that processes spreadsheets privately in the browser.
overview: Excel Whisper is an AI-powered Excel analysis tool with a privacy-first design: files are parsed locally in the browser and nothing is stored on its servers. It can analyze uploads, generate charts and insights, and teach Excel skills through interactive guides. A free plan with no login covers basic use; paid tiers raise file and field limits.

excelmatic.verdict: AI Excel copilot that turns plain-language questions into formulas and insights.
overview: ExcelMatic is an AI assistant for spreadsheets that answers questions, writes formulas, and analyzes data from natural-language prompts. It works with Excel and helps users handle complex tasks without memorizing functions. It offers a free version, with paid plans from $9.99 per month.

fathom.verdict: Free AI notetaker with unlimited recordings, instant summaries, and shareable highlight clips.
overview: Fathom records, transcribes, and summarizes Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams calls with one of the most generous free plans in the category: unlimited recordings and storage, with five advanced AI summaries a month. It offers bot or bot-free capture, highlight clips, Ask Fathom search, CRM sync, and coaching scorecards. Superhuman acquired Fathom in September 2026; it keeps running as a standalone app.
features: Automatic recording, transcription, and summaries for Zoom, Meet, and Teams
Unlimited recordings and storage on the free plan
Instant AI summaries and action items after each call
Highlight clips of key moments to share with the team
Ask Fathom: search across past conversations
CRM sync with HubSpot, Salesforce, Close, and Asana
Summary templates (BANT, Sandler, custom) and AI Scorecards coaching
pros: Most generous free tier in the category: unlimited recordings with no time limit
Clean, simple setup with a minimal learning curve
Bot-free capture option available for sensitive calls
cons: Advanced AI summaries limited to five a month on the free plan
Zoom, Meet, and Teams only — no Webex or other platforms
Desktop apps are Mac and Windows only; no mobile or Linux support

featureshark.verdict: AI-powered customer feedback platform with prioritization, roadmaps, and changelogs.
overview: FeatureShark is a product management suite that pulls customer feedback from multiple channels into one place and uses AI to analyze, score, and prioritize feature requests. It pairs feedback management with roadmaps, surveys, support tooling, and automated changelogs, helping teams decide what to build next based on evidence rather than noise. Impact analytics surface which requests would move the needle most.
pros: AI removes noise from feedback triage
cons: Paid-only with no free tier mentioned
Competes with well-established players like Canny and Productboard
Best suited to teams, not solo founders

feedlog.verdict: Open-source feedback boards, roadmap, and changelog with built-in AI.
overview: FeedLog is an open-source (MIT) feedback management tool with built-in AI: collect user feedback, manage feature requests, run a public roadmap, and publish changelogs, either self-hosted on your own infrastructure or on the free managed cloud. Its AI detects duplicate requests, merges similar feedback, and generates release notes in your brand voice. The self-hosted version has no limits on tracked users, boards, or admin seats.
features: Feedback boards with voting and comments
Embeddable feedback widget for any website
AI duplicate detection and semantic merge
AI changelog generator in your brand voice
pros: Built-in AI included, not a paid add-on.
Board + roadmap + changelog in one tool.
cons: AI features are optional and need your own API key for full power.
Small team project, not an enterprise vendor.
Migration tooling from Canny/Featurebase is still being built.

fellow-ai.verdict: AI meeting assistant built around collaborative agendas, bot-free capture, and strict org-level recording controls.
overview: Fellow AI covers the full meeting lifecycle: shared agendas, recording, transcription, summaries, and action-item tracking. Its defining strength is governance — org-wide recording policies, botless capture, transcript redaction, and SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance. Ask Fellow searches the company's entire meeting history, and notes sync into CRMs and AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude via MCP.
features: AI meeting summaries, transcripts, and action items across Zoom, Teams, Meet, and in-person
Collaborative agendas and org-wide meeting templates
Ask Fellow: AI search across the entire meeting history
Botless recording option alongside bot-based capture
Configurable retention policies including zero-day retention
Transcript and summary redaction with consent capture
CRM sync (Salesforce, HubSpot) and MCP connector for Claude and ChatGPT
Org-wide meeting analytics and compliance portal
pros: Collaborative pre-meeting agendas and templates suit manager-led meeting cultures
Granular recording, retention, and redaction controls fit regulated industries
Ask Fellow surfaces decisions and updates from across the whole meeting history
cons: Free plan is capped at 5 lifetime AI notes, too tight to build a habit on
Meaningful CRM integrations require the Business tier, making it one of the pricier options

fenn.verdict: Precision macOS file search powered by natural-language queries.
overview: Fenn is a precision file-search tool for macOS that finds files using natural-language queries instead of exact filenames. Made by France-based MY LITTLE PLANET, it searches inside documents as well as by name, helping users locate buried files quickly. It offers a free version with a $9/month paid tier.
features: Precision search over filenames and contents
pros: Finds files by meaning, not just filename
cons: macOS only
AI capability is narrow — centered on natural-language file search
